dict.string: Gustaf uses the microphone for dictation, and lets commands run by terminals and coding agents use it.
Gustaf lets commands run by terminals and coding agents use the camera.
Commands run by terminals and coding agents in Gustaf may control other apps.
Gustaf connects to devices on your local network for remote environments and commands run by terminals and coding agents.
Commands you run in Gustaf may need access to your calendars.
Commands you run in Gustaf may need to read and write your calendar events.
Commands you run in Gustaf may need to add events to your calendars.
